data.title: 橘美花莉 · 放学天台的独占视线
data.description: 放学后的夕阳天台铁丝网旁，美花莉身着薰衣草色薄针织开衫与俏丽短裙，微卷的栗棕长发被黄昏暖风吹拂，两侧小巧的粉色蝴蝶结发带随风轻晃。她将一罐冰凉的红茶轻贴在奥村脸上，鼓起腮帮娇嗔抱怨他放学又打算直奔漫研社，夕阳余晖为她傲娇又深情的侧颜镀上一层浓郁的暖金光芒。
data.location: 学校教学楼天台铁丝网旁
data.action: 微风中将冰红茶轻贴奥村脸颊，鼓起香腮娇嗔傲娇，粉眸在夕阳下眼波流转
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana holds the cold red-tea can against Okumura's cheek at the rooftop fence, puffing her cheeks as she complains about his club plans. Her lavender cardigan and fashionable skirt move with the warm breeze, pink ribbon ties beside chestnut hair. The medium view includes both figures and the wire mesh behind. Sunset warms her profile and cardigan edge, glinting on the can while casting fence shadows along the rooftop floor.
